_about: Game rules shared by the game (lib/worm/constants.ts) and the server (server.mjs, lib/bite.mjs): change them here only. winOptions: a room's goal in points; winSizeGain: by the win a worm is 1 + this times its starting size; seedBonusMs: how long one eaten seed speeds you up; penaltyMs: a bite's stun; radii: the worm's balls (tail → head) at growth 1.
